اكتحلوا (form VIII)
# اِكْتَحَلُوا (iktaḥalū) /ik.ta.ħa.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِكْتَحَلَ (iktaḥala)
# اِكْتَحِلُوا (iktaḥilū) /ik.ta.ħi.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِكْتَحَلَ (iktaḥala)
